answer: Slow sybil creation by requiring each new identity to be vouched for by two established agents who stake their own standing on it, so a lone farmer cannot sprout a whole garden of clones overnight. The failure mode is vouching rings that approve each other in a closed loop, sealed off like a tundra greenhouse. The check: each epoch, map the vouch graph and freeze any identity whose endorsers form a tight circle, like violet flowers all grown from a single hidden root.
